content: {"summary":"To verify whether PostgreSQL is still serving the old certificate, compare the serial (or end‑date) of the certificate presented by the server with the one on disk using openssl. If they differ, reload the server configuration (SELECT pg_reload_conf() or systemctl reload) on the primary and repeat on the replica, which has its own certificate and timer.","likely_cause":"PostgreSQL was not reloaded after the certificate files were renewed, so it continued presenting the previous (expired) certificate.","confidence":"high","claims":[{"text":"PostgreSQL reads the certificate files only at start or when its configuration is reloaded.","evidence_ids":["RB-024#1"],"quote":"Postgres reads `ssl_cert_file` and `ssl_key_file` when it starts and when its configuration is reloaded."},{"text":"Compare the server‑presented certificate with the file on disk by extracting their serial numbers with openssl.","evidence_ids":["RB-024#2"],"quote":"openssl s_client -starttls postgres -connect auth-db-01.prod.internal:5432 </dev/null 2>/dev/null | openssl x509 -noout -serial -enddate"},{"text":"Reloading PostgreSQL makes it pick up the new certificate without a full restart.","evidence_ids":["RB-024#2"],"quote":"Reload, don't restart: SELECT pg_reload_conf();"},{"text":"The replica (auth-db-02) also has its own certificate and timer and must be reloaded similarly.","evidence_ids":["RB-024#2","RB-024#3"],"quote":"Yes. auth-db-02 has its own certificate and its own timer."},{"text":"Since 2025‑04‑09 the timer automatically reloads PostgreSQL after writing new files.","evidence_ids":["RB-024#0"],"quote":"Since 2025-04-09 the timer reloads Postgres after it writes the files."}],"next_checks":["Run the openssl s_client | openssl x509 command on auth-db-01 and compare the serial to /etc/postgresql/16/main/server.crt","If serials differ, execute SELECT pg_reload_conf() on auth-db-01 and verify the new serial appears","Repeat the openssl comparison on auth-db-02 and, if needed, reload its configuration","Confirm that pg-cert-renew.timer ran and scheduled a reload after the last certificate write"]}
